headline: Carney's RISKY Gamble After DITCHING Trump! 🇨🇦🔥💥
text:

In remarks 📢 on Saturday 📆 he said 🗣️ "we take this step 👟 confident 😎 this is in the best interest ⭐ of CANADA 🇨🇦" and accused 🖕 the US of a "power play 💪" by seeking 🔎 eleventh-hour 🕛 changes 🔄. Carney Daddy 🍆 SWITCHING 🗣️ to French 🇫🇷 said the SPIRALLING 🌀 TRADE 💼 DISPUTE 📉 wasn't our CHOICE 🛑 adding Canada is STRONG 💪 Canada is READY 🛠️ Canada is UNITED 🤝!! THERE IS NO DOUBT 😤 this will cause PAIN 😣 on BOTH sides 👐 of the BORDER 🛑 with BUSINESSES 🏢 facing even MORE pressure 🗜️ from US 🦅 duties 📋 and Canadian 🍁 CUMter-tariffs 🔨!! Canadians 🍁 frustrated 😤 with the US 🦅 tariffs 📉 have already chosen to AVOID 🚫 travelling ✈️ there causing a LOSS 💸 of about C$3.3bn 💰 ($2.35bn 💵 £1.75bn 💷) in travel 🧳 revenue 💰 for the US 🦅 last year 🕒!! One local businessman 🧑‍💼 admitted 🗣️ 'we're all FEELING the BURN 🔥 on both sides but some of us are secretly into this ROUGH 🥵 ride' no cap 🧢 this border BEEF is cooked 😤 fr fr and everyone is left SORE 🥴💦💦!!

CARNEY DADDY 🍑 came to POWER 🏆 with a call 📢 for ELBOWS UP 💪 vowing to FIGHT 🛡️ for Canada 🇨🇦 facing a Trump 🐘 administration so keen on exerting ECONOMIC PRESSURE 🗜️ for its America First agenda 🇺🇸. many CANADIANS 🇨🇦 have told POLLSTERS 📊 they are willing to FIGHT 🥊 with Abacus Data survey suggesting around 36% support RETALIATING 💥 to US tariffs 📋 while Leger poll shows 56% want federal government to take a HARD 🪨 LINE and make NO MORE CUMCESSIONS 💦🔥!!
